frontmatter.name: rust-code-review
frontmatter.description: Review Rust changes in the ShellZip workspace for correctness, error handling, security of untrusted archive input, ownership and performance, concurrency, tests, and API docs. Use when the user asks for a review, audit, or second look at Rust code, a diff, a branch, a PR, or a crate, or asks whether Rust code is safe or idiomatic.

frontmatter.name: rust-performance
frontmatter.description: Benchmark, profile, and optimize Rust code or binary size in the ShellZip workspace — criterion benchmarks, flamegraphs, allocation and streaming fixes, thread scaling, and release-profile tuning (LTO, strip, opt-level z). Use when something is slow, memory-heavy, or too large, or when the user asks to benchmark, profile, optimize, or shrink a binary.

frontmatter.name: rust-quality-gate
frontmatter.description: Run and fix the ShellZip Rust quality gate — rustfmt, clippy with -D warnings, workspace tests, rustdoc, optional cargo-deny and cargo-audit. Use before finishing any Rust change, when CI fails on fmt, clippy, or tests, or when the user asks to lint, format, fix warnings, or make CI green.
